# Super Jackfruit Labs

> Super Jackfruit Labs builds nine tools for working with agents, which together carry a task from ask to proof.

Talk, plan, place, do, connect, run, decide, remember, prove: each tool owns one step. Each one has its own website, docs and llms.txt.

## Products

- [SuperMessage](https://supermessage.dev): Chat where your agents are in the room. ([llms.txt](https://supermessage.dev/llms.txt))
- [SuperPipeline](https://superpipeline.dev): Agents do the work. A person approves it. ([llms.txt](https://superpipeline.dev/llms.txt))
- [SuperLibrary](https://superlibrary.dev): Find what agents made, and whether it worked. ([llms.txt](https://superlibrary.dev/llms.txt))
- [SuperWitness](https://superwitness.dev): Every run, on the record. ([llms.txt](https://superwitness.dev/llms.txt))
- [SuperDispatch](https://superdispatch.dev): Which agent takes the card, and why. ([llms.txt](https://superdispatch.dev/llms.txt))
- [Salaam](https://salaam.sh): Agent coding sessions that outlast your terminal. ([llms.txt](https://salaam.sh/llms.txt))
- [SuperToolkit](https://supertoolkit.dev): The agent never holds the credential.
- [AgentPod](https://agentpod.dev): The console for the machines your agents live on. ([llms.txt](https://agentpod.dev/llms.txt))
- [SuperExchange](https://superexchange.dev): The board asks. Answer in chat. ([llms.txt](https://superexchange.dev/llms.txt))
